standard.name: ISO 13485
standard.description: Medical Devices - Quality Management Systems - Requirements for Regulatory Purposes

categories.name: Quality Management System
categories.description: QMS requirements specific to medical device lifecycle

categories.name: Product Realization
categories.description: Processes from planning through service provision

clauses.title: Quality Management System
clauses.description: Organizations must establish, document, and maintain their QMS, ensuring its effectiveness
clauses.helpText: Review QMS documentation, procedures, and risk-based approach implementation

clauses.title: General requirements
clauses.description: Document the QMS, maintain its effectiveness, establish all necessary requirements, procedures, activities, and apply risk-based approach
clauses.helpText: Check QMS documentation and risk management approach under regulatory requirements

clauses.title: Documentation requirements
clauses.description: Documented statements of quality policy and objectives, quality manual, required procedures, records, and documents necessary for process control
clauses.helpText: Verify quality manual, documented procedures, work instructions, and records

clauses.title: Management Responsibility
clauses.description: Top management commitment to the QMS, customer focus, quality policy, planning, responsibilities, and management review
clauses.helpText: Evidence of top management involvement and commitment to medical device quality

clauses.title: Management commitment
clauses.description: Evidence of top management commitment to QMS development and implementation
clauses.helpText: Management reviews, resource allocation, and QMS effectiveness monitoring

clauses.title: Customer focus
clauses.description: Ensuring customer requirements and applicable regulations are determined and met
clauses.helpText: Processes for determining and meeting customer and regulatory requirements

clauses.title: Quality policy
clauses.description: Establish a quality policy that provides framework for objectives, is understood, and regularly reviewed
clauses.helpText: Quality policy appropriate for medical device organization and regulatory environment

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Setting quality objectives at relevant functions and levels, planning to maintain QMS integrity during changes
clauses.helpText: Quality objectives aligned with policy and medical device requirements

clauses.title: Responsibility, authority and communication
clauses.description: Documenting and communicating responsibilities and authorities, appointing management representative, establishing internal communication
clauses.helpText: Organization charts, job descriptions, management representative appointment

clauses.title: Management review
clauses.description: Conducting reviews of QMS at planned intervals to ensure continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness
clauses.helpText: Management review meetings, inputs, outputs, and documented decisions

clauses.title: Resource Management
clauses.description: Provision of resources, human resources, infrastructure, and work environment needed for QMS
clauses.helpText: Resources for medical device quality and regulatory compliance

clauses.title: Provision of resources
clauses.description: Determining and providing resources needed for QMS implementation and maintenance
clauses.helpText: Resource planning and allocation for medical device operations

clauses.title: Human resources
clauses.description: Ensuring personnel competency, providing training, maintaining records
clauses.helpText: Training records, competency assessment, qualification for medical device work

clauses.title: Infrastructure
clauses.description: Providing and maintaining infrastructure such as facilities, equipment, and support services
clauses.helpText: Facilities, equipment maintenance, and support systems for medical device production

clauses.title: Work environment and contamination control
clauses.description: Defining requirements for work environment including health, cleanliness, clothing, and documented controls for contamination
clauses.helpText: Cleanroom requirements, contamination control for sterile devices, environmental monitoring

clauses.title: Product Realization
clauses.description: Planning, customer-related processes, design, purchasing, production, and service provision for medical devices
clauses.helpText: Full product lifecycle from design through service for medical devices

clauses.title: Planning of product realization
clauses.description: Planning processes needed for product realization including documented risk management
clauses.helpText: Product development plans with risk management integrated throughout

clauses.title: Customer-related processes
clauses.description: Determining and reviewing product requirements, regulatory requirements, user training, customer communication
clauses.helpText: Requirements determination, contract review, and customer communication processes

clauses.title: Design and development
clauses.description: Documented procedures for design planning, inputs, outputs, reviews, verification, validation, transfer, and change control. Maintain design files
clauses.helpText: Design control process per regulatory requirements (FDA 21 CFR 820.30, EU MDR), DHF maintenance

clauses.title: Purchasing
clauses.description: Documented procedures for purchasing, supplier evaluation/selection, purchasing information, verification of purchased products
clauses.helpText: Supplier qualification, approved supplier list, purchasing controls per ISO 13485:2016 7.4

clauses.title: Production and service provision
clauses.description: Controlling production, cleanliness, installation, servicing, requirements for sterile devices, validation, identification, traceability, customer property, preservation
clauses.helpText: Production controls, sterilization validation for sterile devices, UDI/traceability for implants

clauses.title: Control of monitoring and measuring equipment
clauses.description: Procedures for control, calibration, and validation of monitoring/measuring equipment and software
clauses.helpText: Calibration program, measurement system analysis, software validation

clauses.title: Measurement, Analysis and Improvement
clauses.description: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, improvement processes including feedback, complaints, internal audits
clauses.helpText: Post-market surveillance, complaint handling, CAPA system per regulatory requirements

clauses.title: General
clauses.description: Planning for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and improvement
clauses.helpText: Quality metrics, KPIs, and measurement planning

clauses.title: Monitoring and measurement
clauses.description: Feedback, complaint handling, regulatory reporting, internal audits, process/product monitoring and measurement
clauses.helpText: Complaint system, adverse event reporting, vigilance, internal audit program

clauses.title: Control of nonconforming product
clauses.description: Procedures for controlling nonconforming products before and after delivery, rework procedures
clauses.helpText: Nonconformance handling, product recall procedures, advisory notices

clauses.title: Analysis of data
clauses.description: Collecting and analyzing data using statistical techniques to demonstrate QMS suitability and effectiveness
clauses.helpText: Statistical analysis of quality data, trend analysis, post-market surveillance data

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: General improvement requirements, corrective actions, and preventive actions (CAPA)
clauses.helpText: CAPA system with root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, regulatory reporting
